description:
# Why

After reading this report https://github.com/expo/expo/discussions/33684 I realized that we need to document the difference between setting `player.currentTime` and `player.seekBy(seconds)`.

# How

Updated the documentation for these two approaches to explain the difference in seeking precision.

# Test Plan

/versions/latest/sdk/video/#currenttime
